name: AgentoWine – AI Wine Assistant
author: agentowine

sections.description:
AgentoWine Chatbot is the official plugin to integrate the AgentoWine AI chatbot into your WordPress site.

Main features:

  • 🍷 Virtual AI Sommelier — an intelligent assistant specialized in the world of wine
  • 🎯 Simple setup — just enter your Client ID to activate the chatbot
  • 🌐 Multilingual — supports Italian and English (automatically detects your site language)
  • 🎨 Elegant design — blends in with any WordPress theme
  • 📍 Flexible positioning — choose one of the four corners or set custom coordinates for desktop and mobile
  • 📱 Mobile responsive — works on desktop, tablet and smartphone
  • ⚡ Lightweight — the chatbot script is loaded in the footer and does not slow down your site

Ideal for:

  • Wineries and wine producers
  • Online wine shops
  • Wine bars and restaurants
  • Wine e-commerce stores
  • Wine blogs

An active AgentoWine subscription and a Client ID are required to use the chatbot. Visit agentowine.com for more information.

External Services

This plugin relies on AgentoWine, a third-party service, to provide its functionality. The plugin does not load anything and does not send any data until you enter your Client ID in the settings page.

Once a Client ID is configured, the plugin loads the chatbot widget script from https://chatbot.agentowine.com/chatbot.js on the public pages of your site. When the chatbot is active, the following data is sent to AgentoWine servers:

  • the configured Client ID, to identify your AgentoWine account, on every page where the widget is loaded;
  • the messages that your visitors type into the chat, in order to generate the assistant’s replies;
  • standard technical data included in any web request (such as IP address, browser user agent and site language).

The AgentoWine service is provided by AgentoWine (https://agentowine.com):

  • Terms and Conditions: https://agentowine.com/termini-e-condizioni
  • Privacy Policy: https://agentowine.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload the agentowine-chatbot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → AgentoWine Chatbot
  4. Enter your Client ID (provided by AgentoWine)
  5. Save the settings

The chatbot will automatically appear on all pages of your site, in the position you selected.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Client ID?

Your Client ID is provided when you activate the AgentoWine service. Contact info@agentowine.com or visit agentowine.com for more information.

Can I customize the position of the chatbot?

Yes. You can choose one of the four corners of the screen, or enable custom positioning and set exact pixel coordinates, separately for desktop and mobile.

Can I customize the appearance of the chatbot?

Advanced customizations (colors, theme) are managed from the AgentoWine control panel. The WordPress plugin uses the optimal default settings.

Does the chatbot slow down my site?

No. The chatbot script is loaded in the footer and does not impact the initial rendering of your pages. Nothing is loaded at all until you configure a Client ID.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, the chatbot is designed to work with any WordPress theme.

Can I use the chatbot in a different language?

The chatbot automatically detects the language of your WordPress site. It currently supports Italian and English.
